accounts.connection.exportDescription: Exports the server URL, archive password and installation preferences. Login credentials are excluded.
accounts.connection.imported: Connection imported. Sign in with your own account to apply its installation preferences.
accounts.connection.includePassword:
Include the archive password in this connection file?

It will be stored as plain text. Login passwords, session tokens and API keys are never exported.
accounts.connection.offline: No connection to the server. You are now in offline mode.
accounts.connection.online: Connected to the server. You're back online.
accounts.editor.description: Change the server or the username of this profile. Passwords are not stored; you enter them at the next login.
accounts.editor.serverHint: Changing the server signs this profile out.
accounts.editor.title: Edit Profile
accounts.form.connectFailed: Failed to connect to server. Please check the URL.
accounts.form.duplicate: Profile with this name already exists

accounts.form.noAuth: No authentication methods are currently available on this server.
accounts.form.sso: Sign in/up using your Identity Provider
accounts.headers.description: Headers sent with every request to your PlayStash server, for example Cloudflare Access service tokens. They apply to all profiles and are never sent to other hosts.
accounts.headers.name: Name
accounts.headers.native: Send server requests through the desktop app

accounts.headers.title: Additional Request Headers
accounts.incompatible.description: Your PlayStash client is not compatible with the PlayStash server you are using (older than {version}). Update the server to continue.
accounts.incompatible.title: CLIENT-SERVER-INCOMPATIBILITY DETECTED
accounts.legacy.caption: Previous PlayStash client
accounts.legacy.description: Imports profiles, settings and request headers of PlayStash 1.x for Windows. Saved sessions are taken over where possible.
accounts.legacy.done: Imported {profiles} profiles; {sessions} can log in without a password.
accounts.legacy.installsLater: Games installed by the previous client can be adopted after you log in.
accounts.legacy.none: No profiles of the previous client were found.
accounts.legacy.offer: Import profiles and settings from the previous PlayStash client?
accounts.legacy.offerDescription: You can also do this later under Settings → Account.
accounts.legacy.title: Import from the previous client
accounts.legacyInstalls.description: Games installed by the previous client are moved into the current folder layout (or linked in place) so they show as installed.
accounts.legacyInstalls.modes: Moving keeps everything on the same drive and is instant. Keeping them in place links the old folders into the new layout instead.
accounts.legacyInstalls.none: No games of the previous client were found in your download locations.
accounts.legacyInstalls.title: Adopt {count} legacy installations
accounts.logout.allConfirm: Are you sure you want to log out from all devices?
accounts.logout.allDescription: Ends every session of your account, including other computers and browsers.
accounts.logout.confirm: Are you sure you want to log out?
accounts.logout.deviceDescription: Ends this session on the server and removes it from this device.

accounts.pending.title: Your Account is pending Admin Approval

accounts.picker.description: Pick an account to sign in, or add a new one.
